scope: Prospective E2/E3 sensitivity operators and transparent E3-E5 reanalysis following code review. Not an outcome-blind preregistration: seq2-4 interim results had already been inspected.
historical_results: Do not modify or relabel previous rows, the running pinned Kaggle revision, or primary operators. New runs require separate shard directories and fresh E0.

taxonomy.sensitivity: contour_union: union mixed-coverage cells with the inner contour of coverage>=0.5 using 3x3 erosion, zero outside image; then apply existing band dilation and near-background rule.
taxonomy.interpretation: Primary taxonomy tests mixed-coverage boundary cells, not every geometric boundary. Report skips by cluster, bank, category and object size where measured.

spatial_control.sensitivity: frame_distance: sample without replacement within each memory frame and integer-distance bin, preserving exact reference counts in each frame/bin. Reference overlap remains allowed.
spatial_control.restriction: Sensitivity rows must not be pooled with primary rows or used to select registered E6 weights.

E5.historical_endpoint: agreement: query-region attention versus whole-object boundary-F harm per token, explicitly labeled global effect
E5.local_endpoint: query_specific_agreement: same query-region attention versus signed Dice harm within that query region; whole-sequence bootstrap; require all four finite category effects; never replace missing local effects with global effects.
E5.interpretation: Descriptive reanalysis. Background hard-mask Dice may be degenerate when no foreground occurs in that region.

E3_E4.primary: Retain registered sequence-random-intercept mixed model and Holm correction.
E3_E4.sensitivity: Statsmodels OLS with sequence-clustered sandwich covariance, finite-sample covariance and degrees-of-freedom corrections, joint interaction F test and separate Holm family. Same independent-unit labels as primary; arbitrary within-cluster dependence allowed.
E3_E4.limitations: Different estimator, not proof of primary correctness. Unavailable for insufficient clusters or singular interaction covariance. Warn below 30 clusters; this threshold does not guarantee reliable inference above it. Never substitute sensitivity for a failed or nonsignificant primary result.
